description: This header file declares functions related to constructing boot configuration arguments from a configuration object, including converting arguments to a string with a separator. It defines function signatures but contains no implementations.
external_methods: Result<std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>> BootconfigArgsFromConfig(const CuttlefishConfig&, const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific&)
Result<std::string> BootconfigArgsString(const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>&, const std::string&)

methods.name: BootconfigArgsFromConfig
methods.description: Generates a map of boot configuration arguments from a given Cuttlefish configuration object and its instance-specific data.

methods.name: BootconfigArgsString
methods.description: Converts a map of boot configuration arguments into a single string, separated by a specified separator.
